board.mafia_sector.title: SECTOR · COUNCIL BOARD
b7.mafia_sector.help: B key or the Dossier item - your cards; right-click the ballot to vote. Commands: /b7 dossier, /b7 info, /b7 reveal <type>, /b7 end
lore.mafia_sector.1.title: Order No. 7
lore.mafia_sector.1.text: Recruit twice as many volunteers as there are places. Volunteering is confirmed by signature. Refusing to sign is confirmed by signature.
lore.mafia_sector.2.title: On the purpose of the protocol
lore.mafia_sector.2.text: We do not care whether they survive. We care whom they choose.
lore.mafia_sector.3.title: Isolation protocol
lore.mafia_sector.3.text: The airlock opens from outside. There is nobody outside. The protocol is considered followed.
lore.mafia_sector.4.title: Reactor RB-7
lore.mafia_sector.4.text: The Reactor needs rotation. Without it the bunker will not last a month. The manual is lost. Parts are in the chest.
lore.mafia_sector.5.title: Observation No. 112
lore.mafia_sector.5.text: The group exiled the surgeon for snoring. A week later the group regretted it. Recommendation: continue the experiment.
lore.mafia_sector.6.title: On the cards
lore.mafia_sector.6.text: Everyone was given a dossier. The dossier does not lie. People lie about the dossier.
lore.mafia_sector.7.title: Food allowance
lore.mafia_sector.7.text: Supplies last for the number of places. Not more. We leave the arithmetic to the group.
lore.mafia_sector.8.title: On the surface
lore.mafia_sector.8.text: We do not collect the exiled. They are left a spyglass: let them watch who took their place.
lore.mafia_sector.9.title: A letter with no address
lore.mafia_sector.9.text: Mum, it is warm here and they feed us. Yesterday they voted against Lyosha. Today everyone pretends there was no Lyosha.
lore.mafia_sector.10.title: Write-off: Bunker 6
lore.mafia_sector.10.text: Facility lost. Cause: Reactor failure. The engineer was exiled in the second round for an unpleasant character.
lore.mafia_sector.11.title: On protection
lore.mafia_sector.11.text: Some participants received the Sector's protection. We do not explain who or why. That is part of the experiment too.
lore.mafia_sector.12.title: Last entry
lore.mafia_sector.12.text: If you are reading this, the experiment goes on. Look at your neighbour. They are thinking whom to vote for.
